title: SnapCart — Full-Stack Grocery Delivery Platform
tagline: Multi-role commerce platform with real-time delivery tracking
description: Built a complete multi-role grocery delivery platform covering customer shopping, inventory management, order processing, payment handling, delivery operations, and real-time communication.
problem: Online grocery delivery requires coordinating multiple stakeholders—customers browsing and ordering, admins managing inventory and orders, and delivery partners fulfilling orders—while ensuring payment security, real-time visibility, and reliable delivery confirmation.
solution: Built a full-stack Next.js platform with three distinct dashboards, secure payment workflows, real-time delivery tracking using Socket.IO and geolocation, radius-based delivery assignment, and AI-powered communication assistance.

roles.name: Customer
features: Add items to cart with Redux state management
Checkout with address and payment method selection
Track delivery in real-time on interactive map
Chat with delivery partner with AI quick-reply suggestions

roles.name: Delivery Partner
features: View order details and customer location

orderLifecycle.description: Customer browses products by category, views details, and adds items to cart
Redux Toolkit manages cart state, quantities, and total calculations
Customer enters delivery address and selects payment method
Razorpay integration with server-side HMAC verification or cash-on-delivery option
Admin assigns order to available delivery partner within 10km radius
Real-time Socket.IO updates show delivery partner location on Leaflet map
Delivery partner enters customer OTP to confirm successful delivery
Order marked complete, email notification sent, status updated

architecture.description: SnapCart uses Next.js 14 for both frontend and API routes, MongoDB for data persistence, Socket.IO for real-time features, and integrates third-party services for payments, media, and AI.

keyFeatures.title: Multi-Role Authentication
keyFeatures.description: NextAuth.js with Google OAuth, credentials login, JWT sessions, and role-based access control. Each role has dedicated dashboard and permissions.

keyFeatures.title: Secure Payments
keyFeatures.description: Razorpay integration with server-side payment verification using HMAC signature validation. Supports both online payment and cash-on-delivery.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Delivery Tracking
keyFeatures.description: Socket.IO broadcasts delivery partner location updates. Customer sees live position on Leaflet map with route visualization and ETA.

keyFeatures.title: Radius-Based Assignment
keyFeatures.description: Delivery assignments consider partner availability and 10km radius from customer location using geolocation calculations.

keyFeatures.title: AI-Powered Chat
keyFeatures.description: Gemini AI analyzes chat context and suggests quick replies for delivery partners, improving response time and communication quality.

keyFeatures.title: OTP Delivery Confirmation
keyFeatures.description: System generates OTP sent to customer. Delivery partner must enter correct OTP to mark order as delivered, preventing fraud.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Next.js for both frontend and API routes
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Unified codebase, simplified deployment, built-in API routes, TypeScript support, and excellent developer experience.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Couples frontend and backend; alternative would be separate services but adds deployment complexity.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Flexible schema for evolving product and order data. Good fit for document-oriented data like orders with nested items.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: No complex joins; relationships handled in application layer. Considered PostgreSQL but prioritized flexibility.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Battle-tested WebSocket library with fallback mechanisms, room-based messaging, and straightforward event handling.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Requires persistent connection; considered polling but real-time updates were core requirement.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Cart state needs to be accessible across components; Redux Toolkit provides clean state management with minimal boilerplate.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Adds bundle size; considered Context API but Redux DevTools and middleware were valuable.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Security requirement: never trust client-side payment success. HMAC signature validation on server ensures payment integrity.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: None—this is a security best practice, not an optimization.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Prevents fraudulent delivery confirmation. Customer receives OTP, partner must enter it, creating two-party verification.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Slight UX friction; considered photo proof but OTP is simpler and more reliable.

challenges.challenge: Coordinating real-time location updates across multiple active deliveries
challenges.solution: Socket.IO rooms per order; only relevant participants receive updates. Geolocation updates throttled to reduce server load.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring payment security and handling edge cases
challenges.solution: Implemented comprehensive payment verification: HMAC validation, status checks, timeout handling, and cash-on-delivery fallback.

challenges.challenge: Managing three different user flows in one codebase
challenges.solution: Role-based routing and components. Middleware checks role; each dashboard has dedicated route structure. Shared components where appropriate.

lessonsLearned: Real-time features add complexity but significantly improve user experience for logistics applications
Payment integration requires careful security considerations and testing of failure scenarios
Role-based access control should be implemented early and consistently across API and UI
Geospatial features (radius calculations, maps) are powerful but require understanding coordinate systems and accuracy
AI assistance works best for specific, well-defined tasks like quick-reply suggestions rather than full automation
